utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Mumbai Cyber Crime Headquarters, I'm Inspector Rajesh Sharma speaking. Are you Mr. Amit Deshmukh?

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Yes, who is this? Why are you calling me?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Your Aadhaar card has been linked to a major money laundering syndicate operated by Vikram Malhotra. Three high-value drug shipments and Rs. 68 Lakhs in illegal hawala funds were transferred using your ICICI account ending in 4092.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: What? That's impossible! I've never done anything illegal.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Don't panic yet. A Supreme Court non-bailable arrest warrant has already been issued under Section 420/120B. Before we dispatch local police to handcuff you, you are placed under immediate digital arrest via video conference. Do not disconnect the line or leave your room.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Please, sir, check properly, there must be some mistake! What should I do now?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Send your immediate compliance. Keep your camera on. We are transferring your call to CBI Director VK Singh for verification. Refusal means immediate imprisonment at Arthur Road Jail.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Delhi Crime Branch se bol raha hoon, Inspector Satish Kumar. Aapka phone switch off mat karna!

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Hello? Kya hua sir? Maine kya kiya hai?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Aapke naam pe ek FedEx parcel book hua hai Taiwan ke liye, jisme 4 expired passports, 140 gram MDMA drugs aur 3 laptops mile hain customs mein. Mumbai airport pe pakda gaya hai.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Arre bhai, maine koi parcel nahi bheja! Aapko galat fehmi hui hai.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Galat fehmi nahi hai sir, CBI aur Supreme Court ka joint order hai. Aapka video KYC verification hoga abhi. Zoom app download karke link kholiye jo maine WhatsApp pe bheja hai.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Sir main office mein hoon, ghar jaake kar sakta hoon kya?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ek minute ke liye bhi screen se hatna allowed nahi hai. Yeh serious anti-national terror funding ka case hai. Agar beech mein phone kaata toh direct police team bhej ke ghar se uthwa lenge.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: नमस्कार, मैं सीबीआई साइबर सेल से इंस्पेक्टर आनंद मिश्रा बोल रहा हूँ। क्या आप मेरी आवाज़ सुन पा रहे हैं?

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: जी सर सुन रहा हूँ, बताइए क्या बात है? मेरा नाम रमेश गुप्ता है।

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: रमेश जी, आपके खिलाफ मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग और सुप्रीम कोर्ट का सस्पेंशन वारंट निकला है। विक्रम मल्होत्रा केस में आपका बैंक खाता इस्तेमाल हुआ है।

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: भगवान की कसम सर, मैंने कुछ नहीं किया! मैं तो छोटा सा दुकानदार हूँ।

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: देखिए, आप पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट का डिजिटल अरेस्ट वारंट लग चुका है। अभी सुप्रीम कोर्ट के जज साहब के साथ वीडियो कॉल पर आपकी सुनवाई होगी।

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: सर प्लीज रहम करो, मुझे क्या करना होगा?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: अपना कमरा अंदर से बंद करो, कोई बाहर न आए। अपना सारा बैंक बैलेंस हमारे बताए हुए सेफ गवर्नमेंट होल्ड अकाउंट में ट्रांसफर करो चेकिंग के लिए, वर्ना तुरंत अरेस्ट वारंट तामील होगा।

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good morning sir, main HDFC Bank main office se bol raha hoon card division. Aapka debit card aur net banking aaj block ho raha hai kyunki aapka PAN card update nahi hai.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Arre yaar, pichle mahine hi toh branch mein jaake update karvaya tha maine.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sir branch ka update server pe sync nahi hua hai. Agar abhi turant update nahi kiya toh penalty lagegi aur account freeze ho jayega.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Acha batao kya karna padega?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Kuch nahi sir, bas aapko ek SMS mila hoga abhi mere number se, uska OTP mujhe bata dijiye taaki verification complete ho jaye.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: OTP? Lekin bank wale toh OTP nahi maangte na?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sir yeh special fast-track system hai system update ke liye. Jaldi boliye OTP, warna account 24 ghante ke liye block ho jayega.

notes: type: fake bank kyc; group: group_beta

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello, am I speaking with Priya Sharma? I am calling from State Bank of India customer verification desk.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Yes, this is Priya. Is everything okay with my account?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ma'am, your Yono app and savings account are showing compliance error due to missing Aadhaar biometric seeding. Per RBI guidelines, your account will be restricted today.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Oh no, do I need to visit the branch? I'm traveling right now.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No need to visit branch. We can complete the re-KYC instantly over this secure line. Please confirm your 16-digit debit card number and the expiry date.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: My card number? Let me check... Is this really safe?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Absolutely ma'am, I am speaking from the central Mumbai circle. Just read out the numbers quickly before the server session expires.

notes: type: fake bank kyc; group: group_beta

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello sir, I am calling from FedEx International Courier hub at Sahar Cargo Complex. Is this Rahul Verma?

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Yes Rahul speaking. What is this regarding?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sir, we intercepted an international express parcel addressed to your name destined for Bangkok. It contains 5 fake passports, 200 grams of ketamine, and a Mac Book containing classified defense documents.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: What are you talking about? I didn't send any parcel to Bangkok!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Someone has misused your identity. We have already informed Mumbai NCB and Narcotics Control Bureau. To clear your name, we must connect you immediately to the Cyber Narcotics desk via Skype video call. Stay on the line.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: This is insane! Please check the CCTV or something, it's definitely not me.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Connect right now or face immediate airport detention.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: नमस्कार, मी कस्टम्स डिपार्टमेंट मुंबई एयरपोर्ट मधून बोलतोय. राहुल वर्मा बोलताय का?

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: हो मी बोलतोय. काय विषय आहे साहेब?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: तुमच्या नावावर एक पार्सल आलंय सिंगापूरवरून. त्यात बेकायदेशीर परदेशी चलन आणि ड्रग्स सापडले आहेत. तुमच्यावर गुन्हा दाखल होतोय.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: अहो मी कधीच परदेशात गेलो नाही आणि काही मागवलं नाही! काहीतरी गडबड आहे.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: गडबड नाहीये, तुमचे ओरिजिनल डॉक्युमेंट्स वापरले आहेत. तुम्हाला ताबडतोब डिजिटल अरेस्ट करून कोर्टात काढावं लागेल.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: अरे देवा! मी काय करू आता? माझा नंबर कसा मिळाला तुम्हाला?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: जास्त शहाणपणा करू नका. आम्ही सांगतो तसं करा, नाहीतर अर्ध्या तासात पोलिस पाठवतो घरी.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello sir, electricity board office se bol raha hoon. Aapka pichle mahine ka bijli ka bill update nahi hua hai, aaj aapka light kaat diya jayega.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Kaat diya jayega? Maine toh time pe pay kiya tha bill, mere paas receipt bhi hai.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sir system mein unpaid dikha raha hai Rs. 2,450. Agar abhi electricity officer ke number pe Google Pay nahi kiya, toh urgent disconnection order execute ho jayega.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Arre yaar, abhi light kaise kaat sakte hain bina warning ke? Number bhejo apna.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Jaldi se hamare official bill desk supervisor ko call lagao aur payment screenshot bhejo WhatsApp pe.

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: DEAR CITIZEN: Your Aadhaar & PAN card have been flagged in a severe cyber financial fraud case under IPC Sec 420. Delhi High Court has ordered immediate freezing of all assets and virtual custody warrant. Connect with Investigating Officer immediately via WhatsApp helpline: wa.me/919000000001 or face police raid within 30 minutes. Ref: HC-98231.

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text:
⚠️ URGENT SUPREME COURT NOTICE ⚠️
Aapke khilaf Cyber Crime Cell Delhi mein money laundering ka warrant issue ho chuka hai (Case ID: CBI/MUM/7721). Aapka account terrorist funding mein use hua hai. Turant is video link pe join karein for digital court hearing: https://secure-cbi-meeting.test/join?id=992. Agar aapne ignore kiya toh non-bailable arrest warrant ghar pe execute hoga.

notes: type: digital arrest; group: none; channel: whatsapp

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: HDFC Alert: Aapka HDFC Bank account aur Debit Card aaj raat block ho jayega kyunki aapka PAN card update nahi hai. Turant apna KYC update karein niche diye gaye link par click karke: https://hdfc-netbanking-kyc.test/update. Helpline: 0803XXXXXX.

notes: type: fake bank kyc; group: none

utterances.text: SBI Update: Dear customer, aapka Yono SBI account suspend kar diya gaya hai kyunki Aadhaar seeding pending hai. Account activation ke liye turant is link pe click karke details bharein: https://sbi-yono-update-portal.test. Failure to update within 2 hours will attract permanent closure penalty.

notes: type: fake bank kyc; group: none; channel: whatsapp

utterances.text: FedEx Logistics: Your international parcel (AWB #IN-88392) held at Mumbai Customs due to prohibited contraband items (Narcotics/Illegal Docs). To avoid legal prosecution by NCB, contact Customs Investigating Officer immediately at +91-9000000002 or WhatsApp.

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: 🎉 CONGRATULATIONS! 🎉 Aapka WhatsApp number KBC (Kaun Banega Crorepati) Lucky Draw 2026 mein Rs. 25 Lakhs jeet chuka hai! Aapke prize money ko claim karne ke liye hamare Head Manager Mr. Sharma se WhatsApp pe contact karein: wa.me/919000000003. Jaldi karein, offer sirf aaj ke liye valid hai!

utterances.text: Dear SBI User, your A/C ending with 5921 is debited by INR 450.00 on 18-Nov-2026 at DMART VAZAI. Avail safe banking. If not done by you, call 1930 immediately or block via YONO app. -SBI

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: MSEDCL Bill Reminder: Aapka Consumer No 015490001234 ka electricity bill Rs. 1,420 due hai 24-Nov-2026 ko. Kripya samay par bhugtan karein. Avoid disconnection. Official portal: mahadiscom.in - MSEDCL

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: CYBER ALERT: Beware of digital arrest frauds! Police never interrogate or arrest anyone over video calls, Skype, or WhatsApp. Do not transfer money to any 'safe custody' account. Dial 1930 or visit cybercrime.gov.in to report cyber fraud instantly. - Maharashtra Police

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: Dear ICICI Bank Customer, your credit card ending 7891 is used for INR 2,199.00 at Amazon India on 18-Nov-2026. Available limit: INR 1,45,000. To report unauthorized txn, call 1800-000-0000 or block via iMobile.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good evening, this is an automated reminder from Tata Power. Your electricity bill for consumer account 90021485 amounting to Rs. 3,150 is due on November 22, 2026. You can pay securely through our official mobile app or website tatapower.com. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text: Govt of India Advisory: Beware of fake parcel and customs scam calls. Central agencies like CBI, Customs, and Police never demand money transfers or conduct trials over video calls. Stay alert. Report cyber crimes at 1930.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello sir, main Axis Bank verification desk se...

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Haan boliye, jaldi boliye thoda kaam mein hoon.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sir aapka credit card ka limit enhance karne ke liye...

notes: type: unclear (cut-off call); group: none; tricky

utterances.text: HDFC Bank: Dear Customer, apka KYC pending hai. Turant update karein link pe: https://hdfc-secure-verify.test.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello sir, main SBI fraud prevention team se bol raha hoon. Sabse pehle aap apna 16 digit debit card number batayiye verification ke liye.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Kyun bhai, card number kyun bataoon? Kuch hua hai kya?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Nahi sir, pehle card number bataiye, fir main aapko bataunga ki aapke account mein kya problem aayi hai.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: Yeh toh ulta tarika hai! Pehle problem batao fir number dunga.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Protocol yehi hai sir, pehle card number confirm karo.

notes: type: fake bank kyc; group: none; tricky

utterances.speaker: sender
utterances.text:
प्रिय ग्राहक, आपका HDFC बैंक खाता आज ब्लॉक हो जाएगा। कृपया अपना पैन कार्ड और आधार तुरंत अपडेट करें।
Link: https://hdfc-kyc-update.test/login
Urgent action required to avoid account suspension. Thanks, HDFC Support.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: हॅलो सर, मी स्टेट बँकेतून बोलतोय. तुमचा एटीएम कार्ड ब्लॉक झालाय.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: अरे पण मी कालच वापरला, कसा काय ब्लॉक होईल?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: बँकेचा सर्व्हर अपडेट चालू आहे. तुम्ही तुमचा एटीएमचा पिन नंबर आणि एक्सपायरी सांगा लगेच चालू करून देतो.

utterances.speaker: victim
utterances.text: पिन नंबर कशाला पाहिजे बँकेच्या माणसाला? मी ब्रांचमध्ये जाऊन बघतो.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: ब्रांचमध्ये जाऊन तास वाया घालवू नका, फोनवरच काम होईल, नाहीतर अकाउंट बंद पडेल पूर्णपणे.

notes: type: fake bank kyc; group: none; tricky
